description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to declare the excisable articles (Motor vehicles etc.) which are exempt from the payment of Excise (Special Provisions) Duty w.e.f. 11.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which exempts certain excisable articles from payment of Excise (Special Provisions) Duty.
